title: Export controls
description: Export bans, licences and quotas on critical minerals since 2020, with status as of 6 November 2026.

records.measure: All exports of nickel ore banned
Exports of high-purity and flake graphite need a licence
Exports of antimony ores, metal and oxides need a licence
Exports to the United States in principle refused
records.status: Suspended until 27 Nov 2026, except for military users
Replaced by quotas from 16 Oct 2025: 96,600 tonnes a year in 2026 and 2027

records.measure: Exports of samarium, gadolinium, terbium, dysprosium, lutetium, scandium and yttrium need a licence

records.mineral: Five more rare earths, battery materials
records.measure: Controls on more rare earths and battery materials, and on foreign-made goods with 0.1% or more Chinese rare earths by value
